svg.title: Figure 3-4: context and boundary of CFG-002, the 2.0 mobile manipulator
svg.desc: The ten decided elements of the 2.0 mobile manipulator in a grid inside a hatched dashed boundary; the operator tablet, the network, bystanders and the mains on the left; the site, a station with shelves and drawers, a person within arm reach and the fleet server on the right; a red note that no repository holds the design.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The ten elements E-11…E-20 of §3.1a inside the boundary; hatched because no repository holds this design: every box is a plan-set claim to verify, not a part that exists.
